ex.text: The Amazon River is a major river in South America, flowing from the Andes mountains in Peru to the Atlantic Ocean in Brazil. It is the largest river in the world by discharge volume, providing approximately 20% of the global riverine freshwater input to the oceans. While its status as the longest river is often debated against the Nile, it drains the vast Amazon Basin, the largest drainage system on Earth. The river supports an immense biodiversity of flora and fauna within the surrounding tropical rainforest. Major urban centers, including Manaus and Iquitos, rely on the waterway for transportation and commerce across the region.
